****_Wonder Woman_ (Volume 5) #52**** is an issue of the series [_Wonder Woman _ (Volume  5)](/wiki/Wonder_Woman_Vol_5 "Wonder Woman Vol 5") with a cover date of [ October, 2018](/wiki/Category:2018,_October "Category:2018, October"). It was published on August 8, 2018.

## Synopsis for "The Enemy of Both Sides, Part One"

_** Between Vanity and Gateway City **_

[Wonder Woman](/wiki/Diana_of_Themyscira_(Prime_Earth) "Diana of Themyscira (Prime Earth)") is executing a mission for [A.R.G.U.S.](/wiki/A.R.G.U.S._(Prime_Earth) "A.R.G.U.S. (Prime Earth)"), coordinated by [Steve Trevor](/wiki/Steve_Trevor_(Prime_Earth) "Steve Trevor (Prime Earth)"), to capture [Death Bat](/wiki/Death_Bat_(Earth_8) "Death Bat (Earth 8)"). During the fight, Diana is interrupted by [a woman](/wiki/Nayeli_Constant_(Prime_Earth) "Nayeli Constant (Prime Earth)") wearing the mask of Aztek: she introduces herself as Nayeli, successor of [Uno](/wiki/Uno_(Prime_Earth) "Uno (Prime Earth)"). She tells Diana she had a vision about an amazon warrior, who Diana recognizes as [Atalanta](/wiki/Atalanta_II_(Prime_Earth) "Atalanta II (Prime Earth)"), imprisoned in a pyramid and fighting in it. There was also a word involved: _Neshny_.
As Diana secures the prisoner, she explains to her that if an amazon is in danger it's her responsibility to act, then informs Aztek about the fact that the word she referred to translates into "Rage", but not in the language of [Themyscira](/wiki/Themyscira "Themyscira"): they will have to make a stop in Oakland to talk with [Artemis](/wiki/Artemis_of_Bana-Mighdall_(Prime_Earth) "Artemis of Bana-Mighdall (Prime Earth)"), champion of the [Amazons of Bana-Mighdall](/wiki/Amazons_of_Bana-Mighdall "Amazons of Bana-Mighdall").

_** Michoacan, Mexico **_

After telling Artemis that Atalanta was alive, as Aztek saw her in a vision, the Banazon accepts taking part in the rescue, as Atalanta is a hero in the tradition of Artemis' people. It seems Atalanta is fighting inside a structure called _Thirteen Heavens_, a temple for the god [Tezcatlipoca](/wiki/Tezcatlipoca_(Prime_Earth) "Tezcatlipoca (Prime Earth)"), enemy of Aztek, built with bricks of [Eighth Metal](/wiki/Eighth_Metal "Eighth Metal"). Breaching the temple, the three warriors find Atalanta who tell them the armies of Tezcatlipoca, the Naguals, are trying to get into Earth to conquer it, and Atalanta alone fought them to keep them away until now. The final confrontation is about to begin: will the three Amazons and Aztek hold and stop Tezcatlipoca from entering Earth, or will they surrender the planet to the evil Aztec god?
